_doc: Rider profile = PHYSICAL (body, energy, skill: what her body can do) + PREFERENCE (what she likes to do, 0..1 = how much / how often) + MIND (how far she looks ahead and how carefully she plans). rider.js reads it at start. Tune freely.
name: Mia

energy._doc: stamina bar [J]; recovery [W] (Cheney 11/08: ~30x the old rates). Walking: steeper than restGradeDeg costs, gentler recovers (walkRestW on the flat). Standing on the board without pumping/pushing recovers rideRestW at <= restFullKmh, fading to 0 at noRestKmh. Sitting is fastest; she sits at least minSitS seconds and gets up at getUpAt. Standing on the board without moves never costs; rideRestW = walkRestW (same as walking on the flat).

skill._doc: pumpGain: how much speed a pump gives per effort; pushForceN: base kick force

preference._moves: random move set while riding calmly: each weight 0..1 = how often she picks it (armStyling, crossStep, pirouette, dance, lookBack, hairTouch); moveGapS = pause between moves [min,max] s; playerTrick = what Enter/tap fires: alternate | pirouette | shove

mind._doc: lookAheadM: how far she reads the road; planEveryS: how often she re-plans; foresight 0..1: 0 = reacts at the last moment, 1 = plans the whole hill (uses momentum, charges speed early); caution 0..1: margin she keeps for energy/speed
